dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Yo! Dear customer, you look like your travels have you absolutely beat. Are you looking for a place to put up your feet and enjoy a cuppa tea?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You have tea here?

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Just so! In fact, this is the only tea stall for miles around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What teas do you have?

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Uh... Uh... Explo... Fiery Explosive Sweet Nectar Tea! Yeah, that's the one.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: It's a special type of tea made from wild Sweet Flowers and the nectar of Whopperflowers. It burns at first, but the aftertaste is cool and refreshing, and it's great for washing away exhaustion! You won't find it anywhere else.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, a tea Paimon's never heard of, and it sounds amazing, too!

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, yours truly has run out of the necessary ingredients. Fortunately, there are some close by, but unfortunately, it's a bit dangerous, since you've gotta pick Sweet Flowers while dealing with <color=#00E1FFFF>Pyro Whopperflowers</color> that just pop up out of nowhere.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: As long as I get enough ingredients to reopen, who cares how big the reward I offer is? I'll make it all back and then some!

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: 'Tis a shame... and embarrassing, to boot, but would you mind just hanging around elsewhere for a bit? I'm going to patter on off to the Adventurers' Guild and get them to help harvest the materials...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good news. We're the Adventurers you're looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Uh... *cough*... This, well...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right, and we've just gotta try that Explosive Sweet Nectar Tea! Just leave the ingredients to us.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Th—The Whopperflowers there are as plentiful as the stones on Mt. Mingyuan! I'd caution against taking such a risk...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...If there really are that many, shouldn't this place be called Whopperflower Mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Uh... Oh! I just remembered! I actually already have a contractual agreement with the Adventurers' Guild. If I simply allowed the two of you to just take over, it wouldn't be proper...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're weird, you know that? Here you've got two readily available Adventurers right in front of you, ready to help, and yet you're backtracking...

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Anyway, though the tea is good, the timing isn't, hehe. I do hope you'll be back, dear customers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure, sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Hey, {NICKNAME}... Whaddaya say we ignore him and just go get the ingredients? We'll be able to try the tea then, right?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Paimon really wants to give that tea he talked up a try!)

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Ah? You... my dear customers, you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here are the ingredients. Tea, please.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: What? Did you guys really deal with the <color=#00E1FFFF>Pyro Whopperflowers</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure, there were quite a few, but for pros like us, it was just a bit of weed-whacking.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Quite a few? Ah, no, no! Yes, yes, yours truly knows just how many there are! The two of you are truly both skilled and courageous! Please, allow me to express my admiration and undying respect!

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: (Good thing these two are okay... I'd lose my job otherwise... Looks like I'll need to try a different excuse next time...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! Looks like you've got no reason not to make us the special Fiery Explosive Sweet Nectar Tea now, right? Because we'd like to drink some, pronto!

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: *ahem*... Yes... Your humble servant will prepare some posthaste...

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: (Blasted... How do I even...? It can't be that hard, right!? It'll be fine if I just dump the Sweet Flowers and Whopperflower Nectar in together, right!?)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Despite the reluctant look on Xuanji's face, he takes out the ingredients you brought and throws it all — lock, stock, and barrel — into a cup. After but the briefest moment of hesitation, he removes a small quantity, but in the end, puts it all back in.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: He then covers it with a lid, and begins shaking it vigorously. Soon after, a brown liquid with a strange foam floating on the surface is brought before you.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You realize something isn't quite right, but Paimon picks it up and drains her cup in a single Paimonial gulp.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: BLEEEECCCH!!! What the heck is that stuff!? Paimon's never drunk anything that terrible before... Just how does your tea stall manage to stay open...

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Ahaha...Ah! S—So sorry! I apologize for the torment inflicted upon your tongue, dear customer...

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Please take this, as a token of my sincerity! Consider it reparations for the crimes committed against your taste buds, and a reward for bringing me the materials...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Fine. Guess you're still an alright person, although your tea-brewing skills are pretty bad...

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't say that... Anyway, thanks to you two, your humble servant finally has all the necessary ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: Now, if you two don't have any other pressing matters about these parts, you should head back as soon as possible. After all, who knows what kind of dangers might be lurking out in the wild?

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
dialogues.text: What is it? Still can't take your minds off the ho.... er, Fiery Explosive Sweet Nectar Tea?

dialogues.speaker: Xuanji
